run_visualize_json_results: run the script to visualize COCO or LVIS JSON predictions as side-by-side images
create_instances_from_predictions: create detectron2 Instances objects from a list of prediction dictionaries with scores and bboxes
visualize_coco_predictions: visualize model predictions on COCO dataset images with configurable confidence threshold
visualize_lvis_predictions: visualize model predictions on LVIS dataset images with category ID mapping
review_create_instances_filtering: review the create_instances function to understand how predictions are filtered by confidence threshold
